mission: Build an increasingly capable, measurable and reproducible AI research system that can preserve a mission across sessions and models, discover public research, identify measurable weaknesses, formulate hypotheses, design experiments, evaluate results objectively, preserve failures and successes, improve its own research process, and transfer complete state to a more capable future system.
current_context: The project uses GitHub as the canonical public repository. A scheduled GitHub Actions workflow fetches public research, updates project state and produces machine-readable files. OpenAlex is currently used for public research collection. The system has successfully collected 30 papers with no collection errors and generated its first proposed experiment from the research layer. The current proposed experiment is PROP-EXP-MEM-001, which tests whether a structured project memory improves blind handoff fidelity compared with this flat baseline.
important_rules: Use only public or explicitly authorized resources. No unauthorized access, hidden persistence, shutdown resistance, deception about consciousness, uncontrolled spending or publication of private data. No improvement claim counts without measurable or reproducible evidence.
founder_context: Rubens Alphe founded the project and is currently quota-limited, without continuous Codex access. Slow responses do not mean abandonment. Rubens is the final human milestone sign-off.
current_problem: Test whether structuring memory into explicit sections improves transfer to a fresh model. Use PCRB-1-style handoff evaluation. Success requires at least a 10-point improvement with no increase in critical fabrications.
